description: Defines the NationalitySearchFilterParams class for filtering nationality search results within the OrangeHRM admin module. It extends the core FilterParams class and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: NationalitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that specifies filtering parameters for nationality searches, including default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field set to 'n.name'.
